# Rifts World Book 11: Coalition War Campaign

Rifts World Book 11: Coalition War Campaign is a 1996 tabletop game supplement published by Palladium Books for Rifts.
Contents
Rifts World Book 11: Coalition War Campaign is a supplement in which the focus is on the authoritarian Coalition States and their leader, Emperor Prosek, whose regime thrives on human supremacy and brutal suppression of dissenters, mages, and aliens. This supplement outlines their readiness to wage war on neighboring lands. Inside, players and gamemasters will find a breakdown of the Coalition's military apparatus—from unit types and deployment strategies to weapon systems, ranks, and commendations. Some content is recycled from earlier publications, and new power armor and mega-damage robots are included. Five pages offer brief scenario seeds.
Reception
Lucya Szachnowski reviewed Rifts World Book 11: Coalition War Campaign for Arcane magazine, rating it a 5 out of 10 overall, and stated that "if you want a lengthy adventure to take your campaign beyond the events of the Juicer Uprising - which this supplement ostensibly follows on from - you are going to have to do a lot of work yourself. There are just five pages of short adventure ideas which are usable and versatile - providing a good mixture of combat and moral dilemmas - but they aren't enough. A further chapter with at least one fully fleshed-out scenario would have increased the supplement's usefulness for any Rifts ref."
